question: Show me all the restaurants located within 500 meters of the Tagus River in Lisbon.
sql: SELECT p.names->>'primary' AS name FROM lisbon_places p WHERE p.basic_category = 'restaurant' AND ST_Distance(p.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('LINESTRING(-9.133333 38.700000, -9.133333 38.750000)', 4326), 'spheroid') < 500

question: Find all places that are located inside the area covered by the road named 'Avenida da Liberdade'.
sql: SELECT p.names->>'primary' AS name FROM lisbon_places p JOIN lisbon_roads r ON ST_Within(p.geometry, r.geometry) WHERE r.names->>'primary' = 'Avenida da Liberdade'

question: List all historical sites that lie within a 1-kilometer radius of the castle in Lisbon.
sql: SELECT p.names->>'primary' AS name FROM lisbon_places p WHERE p.taxonomy->>'primary' = 'historic_site' AND ST_Distance(p.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT(-9.139333 38.709922)', 4326), 'spheroid') < 1000

question: Find any places that are right next to or touching the road called 'Passeio Marítimo de Algés'.
sql: SELECT p.names->>'primary' AS name FROM lisbon_places p JOIN lisbon_roads r ON ST_Touches(p.geometry, r.geometry) WHERE r.names->>'primary' = 'Passeio Marítimo de Algés'

question: Show me all the stores that are located inside the boundaries of the neighborhood called Alfama.
sql: SELECT p.names->>'primary' AS name FROM lisbon_places p WHERE ST_Within(p.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POLYGON((-9.145 38.705, -9.145 38.715, -9.135 38.715, -9.135 38.705, -9.145 38.705))', 4326))

question: Tell me which places are either directly inside or very close to the road segment that has the name 'Rua do Ouro'.
sql: SELECT p.names->>'primary' AS name FROM lisbon_places p JOIN lisbon_roads r ON ST_Intersects(p.geometry, r.geometry) WHERE r.names->>'primary' = 'Rua do Ouro'
